name: popsicle
headline: Content Marketing Team - Automate Content Creation
short_description: Automatically generates marketing content for multiple platforms from a single YouTube video or website URL. Benefits marketing teams by creating newsletters, blog posts, social media posts, and more. Integrates with content management systems and social media platforms.
author: uxjoseph

sections.overview:
This skill analyzes YouTube videos or website URLs and automatically generates multiple marketing content formats including newsletters, SEO-optimized blog posts, X/Twitter threads, LinkedIn posts, YouTube scripts, shorts scripts, card-style visuals, thumbnails, and edited short-form videos. It works by extracting key messages from your source content and distributing them across platform-specific formats optimized for each channel. The skill is built on an AI agent team that handles content planning, creation, quality review, and visual/video generation, saving marketing teams significant time on content repurposing. It's designed for solo entrepreneurs, content creators, marketers, and personal brands who need to maintain a multi-platform presence without manual content adaptation.
Convert a single YouTube video into 10 pieces of platform-specific content in minutes
Generate SEO-optimized blog posts and newsletters from source URLs automatically
Create X/Twitter threads, LinkedIn posts, and shorts scripts from one piece of content
Produce visual assets like thumbnails and card-news slides without design skills
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/uxjoseph/content-marketing-team`
sections.usage:
```
Turn the YouTube video [URL] or website [LINK] into 10 pieces of marketing content for [TEAM/COMPANY]. Start with a 300-word blog post summarizing the key points. Then create a 150-word LinkedIn newsletter with a hook and a call-to-action. Next, draft 5 social media posts (Twitter, Instagram, Facebook) with platform-specific tweaks. Finally, generate a 200-word email newsletter with subject line ideas. Use [TOPIC] or [FOCUS AREAS] to guide the tone.
```
Copy

```
The YouTube video titled 'How AI is Transforming Sales in 2024' from the channel 'Tech Trends Weekly' was used as the source for this content marketing exercise. The blog post, titled 'The AI Sales Revolution: What You Need to Know', opened with: 'Sales teams are scrambling to keep up with AI-driven tools in 2024—but many are using them wrong. A new YouTube video from Tech Trends Weekly reveals how top performers are leveraging AI to close more deals, faster.' It then summarized the key points from the video, including fictional data like: 'Companies using AI tools saw a 42% increase in qualified leads, according to the video's analysis of 2023 sales data.'

The LinkedIn newsletter, titled 'Is Your Sales Team Falling Behind in AI?', included a hook: 'If your sales team isn't using AI tools by 2024, they're already behind.' It then provided a call-to-action: 'Download our free guide on the top 5 AI tools for sales teams this week.'

The social media posts were tailored for each platform. The Twitter post read: 'Sales teams using AI tools in 2024 are seeing a 42% increase in qualified leads. Is yours? [LINK] #AISales #SalesTools'. The Instagram post included a carousel with the key points from the video and a caption: 'Swipe to see how top sales teams are using AI in 2024. [LINK]'. The Facebook post was longer and included a video embed suggestion: 'Watch this new video on how AI is transforming sales teams in 2024. Share your thoughts below!'.

The email newsletter, titled 'Your Weekly Guide to AI in Sales', included subject line ideas like: 'How AI is Boosting Your Sales Team in 2024' and 'The Top AI Tools for Sales Teams This Week'. The newsletter then provided a summary of the key points from the video and a link to the blog post for further reading. It also included a call-to-action to share the post with their network.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
